messages:
Priya K: Vendor update from NexaSupply — allocation for H100s dropped to 12 units, ETA slipped ~3 weeks. They flagged a brokerage charge for RMA air replacements. Do we accept a split shipment or force a consolidated AWB?
Danielle: Split AWBs increase customs risk. If we go split we need per-AWB paperwork and separate invoice lines. Any idea on cost delta?
Marco: Vendor quoted +$900/unit for air expedite, plus ~$1.5k brokerage per AWB. They suggested consolidating RMA units to one AWB to save brokerage but that adds 4–7 days transit.
Liam: We have a Dedicated commit needing ~20 GPUs next month. 12 confirmed isn't enough. Can we top up with H200s or swap with another vendor? What's the performance tradeoff for the workloads?
Priya K: Ops note — DOA RMA SLA from depot is: domestic 5d, cross-border 10d. If vendor consolidates AWBs, RMA returns will queue at the depot longer. Also: vendor mentioned temporary IDs for serial mismatch. Do not accept temp IDs without photos + vendor-signed manifest.
Danielle: I'll loop in @Procurement Team and @Legal. Procurement: can you push NexaSupply to absorb brokerage for DOA replacements? If they won't, we need to quantify impact to unit economics.
Procurement Team: Opening negotiation thread with NexaSupply now. Initial ask: vendor to cover brokerage for DOA and provide explicit AWB-level insurance. We have leverage on next quarter commit.
Marco: Also flagging: batch 7 shows 2 serial mismatches vs manifest. Vendor proposes re-serializing at depot; we should insist on pre-shipment reconciliation or photo evidence before acceptance.
Priya K: Temporary mitigation: redeploy non-latency-critical workloads to eu-region cluster; frees up backlog for dedicated slots. Can infra re-route jobs if we accept H200s as stopgap?
Liam: Yes, we can move batch jobs to eu-region for 72–96h window. But note increased inter-region egress and slightly higher tail latency. I'll estimate cost delta and post numbers.
OpsBot: [automated] RMA case created: NX-2026-00421. Depot ETA (if consolidated): 2026-04-08. DOA SLA flagged.
Danielle: Fine plan. Next steps: procurement to push vendor on brokerage, Marco to demand photo manifest + serial reconciliation pre-shipment, Liam to estimate cost/latency for eu failover, Priya to confirm whether we accept split AWB if vendor refuses to cover brokerage.
Priya K: Agree. One more — if vendor insists on temp IDs, we block acceptance at receiving and escalate to vendor ops. No temporary serials in prod pools. :no_entry_sign:
Marco: Noted. I'll draft the acceptance checklist and add to the receiving runbook (snippet):
```
- Verify vendor manifest vs photos
- Confirm AWB and invoice match
- Reject temp serials; require vendor-signed exception
- Log RMA case ID (NX-2026-00421)
```
Danielle: Thanks. Will follow up once procurement has vendor reply. :thumbsup:
